record.original_question: Fix a prime p > 2 and a power q of p. Let L(u, f, psi) be the Artin-Schreier L-function attached to a rational function f in F_q(x) and an additive character psi. For the families AS_d^ord = {f = h/g : h, g in F_q[x], (g,h)=1, g squarefree, deg f = max(deg h, deg g) = d, deg g in {d, d-1}}, AS_d^0 = {f in F_q[x] : deg f = d, (d,p)=1}, and AS_d^{0,odd} = {f in F_q[x] : deg f = d, f(x) = -f(-x), (d,2p)=1}, with q fixed and d -> infinity and with M_k denoting the k-th moment of L(q^(1/2), f, psi), compute the listed low moments and extend the 1-level density of zeros beyond the currently stated support ranges: for AS_d^ord, compute M1 through M6 and prove 1-level density for support of phi-hat inside (-1-delta, 1+delta) or (-2-delta, 2+delta); for AS_d^0, compute M1 through M4 and prove 1-level density for support inside (-(2-2/p)-delta, 2-2/p+delta); for AS_d^{0,odd}, compute M1 and M2 and prove 1-level density for support inside (-(1-1/p)-delta, 1-1/p+delta).

evidence.quote: Compute moments for families of Artin-Schreier L-functions and improve results on 1-level zero density.
AS ord : compute 1-level density for supp φ̂ ⊂ (-1 - δ, 1 + δ) for some δ > 0 or (-2 - δ, 2 + δ), for some δ > 0. Compute M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6.
AS 0 : compute 1-level density for supp φ̂ ⊂ (-(2 - 2/p) - δ, 2 - 2/p + δ). Compute M1, M2, M3, M4. AS 0,odd : compute 1-level density for supp φ̂ ⊂ (-(1 - 1/p) - δ, 1 - 1/p + δ). Compute M1, M2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p > 2 be a prime and let q be a power of p. Fix a non-trivial additive character ψ : F_q → C^×. For a rational function f ∈ F_q(x) (with poles avoiding the relevant points), let

  L(u, f, ψ) = ∏ (1 - α_i(f, ψ) u)

be the Artin–Schreier L-function attached to f and ψ, normalized so that its inverse zeros α_i lie on the circle |α| = q^{1/2}. Define the k-th moment

  M_k(F_d) = (1/|F_d|) Σ_{f ∈ F_d} L(q^{-1/2}, f, ψ)^k

for any finite family F_d of such f's, and consider the 1-level density

  D(F_d; φ) = (1/|F_d|) Σ_{f ∈ F_d} Σ_j φ( (deg L) · θ_j(f) / (2π) ),

where e^{iθ_j(f)} ranges over the unitarized inverse zeros of L(u, f, ψ) and φ is a Schwartz test function whose Fourier transform φ̂ has compact support.

Consider the three families, with q fixed and d → ∞:

(i) The ordinary family
  AS_d^{ord} = { f = h/g : h, g ∈ F_q[x], gcd(g,h) = 1, g squarefree, deg f := max(deg h, deg g) = d, and deg g ∈ {d, d-1} }.

(ii) The polynomial (p-rank 0) family
  AS_d^{0} = { f ∈ F_q[x] : deg f = d, gcd(d, p) = 1 }.

(iii) The odd-polynomial family
  AS_d^{0,odd} = { f ∈ F_q[x] : deg f = d, f(x) = -f(-x), gcd(d, 2p) = 1 }.

Solve the following:

(A) For AS_d^{ord}, compute the asymptotics as d → ∞ of M_1, M_2, M_3, M_4, M_5, M_6, and prove that the 1-level density D(AS_d^{ord}; φ) agrees with the prediction of the corresponding random-matrix symmetry type for all φ with supp(φ̂) ⊂ (-1 - δ, 1 + δ) (or, in a strengthened form, ⊂ (-2 - δ, 2 + δ)) for some δ > 0.

(B) For AS_d^{0}, compute the asymptotics of M_1, M_2, M_3, M_4, and prove the 1-level density for all φ with supp(φ̂) ⊂ (-(2 - 2/p) - δ, 2 - 2/p + δ) for some δ > 0.

(C) For AS_d^{0,odd}, compute the asymptotics of M_1 and M_2, and prove the 1-level density for all φ with supp(φ̂) ⊂ (-(1 - 1/p) - δ, 1 - 1/p + δ) for some δ > 0.

In each case, the support range strictly extends what is currently known.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., "Moments of Artin–Schreier L-functions," Quarterly J. Math., 2024) computes some low moments and 1-level densities for the ordinary, polynomial, and odd-polynomial Artin–Schreier families, including the second absolute moment with a lower-order term and 1-level densities in restricted support ranges. However, the full set of higher moments (M_3–M_6 for the ordinary family, M_3–M_4 for the polynomial family, M_2 for the odd-polynomial family) and the requested extensions of the 1-level density support beyond current bounds do not appear fully resolved in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Moments of Artin-Schreier L-functions
status_evidence.snippet: We compute moments of L-functions associated to the polynomial, odd polynomial, and ordinary families of Artin-Schreier covers... The kth moment is computed for a large range of values of k, depending on the sizes of p and q.
status_evidence.claim: Some moments and 1-level densities of these three Artin–Schreier families have been computed, but only over restricted ranges of k and support.

status_evidence.title: Moments of Artin–Schreier L-functions | Quarterly J. Math.
status_evidence.snippet: The 1-level zero-density is computed for the ordinary and odd-polynomial families with test functions with Fourier transform supported in a suitable interval.
status_evidence.claim: Current 1-level density results hold only on restricted support intervals, leaving extensions beyond these supports open.
